summary: Prenetics Global (NASDAQ: PRE) furnished a Form -6-K on 2026-11-03 disclosing a planned CFO succession: Brian J. Rosin becomes CFO effective 2026-12-31, succeeding Stephen Lo, with board formalization expected at the 2026-11-12 meeting. Rosin, IM8 CFO since May 2026, serves as CFO-designate through year-end and continues leading IM8 finance; no separate IM8 CFO will be named. The company cites IM8 representing substantially all revenue, a US-based finance build-out, and Rosin's role in a $1 billion General Catalyst Customer Value Fund commitment. Q3 2026 results are due 2026-11-18. No deal terms; watch execution on US listing and financing milestones.
